'''Worm''' was a person of unidentified [[Species/Legends|species]] who was only five feet tall. This person was seen in [[Depatar/Legends|Depatar]], the [[City/Legends|City]] of Masks, in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]]. Like all the visitors and many inhabitants, this person was in disguise, particularly with hundreds of holo-projectors under the suit to simulate a covering of living, crawling [[Worm/Legends|worms]] around the body. Worm approached other dancers to scare them, and then laughed out loud in their faces.
